### Caesars Palace Launches Second Major Renovation of Bacchanal Buffet, Reimagining Its Global Kitchens


11/18/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 512 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/508919455/files/doc_news/Caesars-Palace-Launches-Second-Major-Renovation-of-Bacchanal-Buffet-Reimagining-Its-Global-Kitchens-2026.pdf)


[*Download existing high-res images of Bacchanal Buffet*](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdrive.google.com%2Fdrive%2Ffolders%2F1YrUuRjw4DAjlPm4HgTxV-baCS3WmpYhk%3Fusp%3Dsharing&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=*Download+existing+high-res+images+of+Bacchanal+Buffet*&index=1&md5=8b5c9dc42bad9609a4835185272a8200)


**Key Facts:**


- Bacchanal Buffet at Caesars Palace will temporarily close on Jan. 4, 2027, for renovations and is scheduled to reopen in summer 2027.
- The 2027 renovation will enhance several specialty kitchens and the dessert station.
- Reservations are available through Jan. 3, 2027, before the transformation begins and can be made at[caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&index=2&md5=acf92836086158c7bdf113da1355a698) .


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Caesars Palace is reimagining Bacchanal Buffet for a new era. Following its 2021 refresh, one of the city's largest buffets is getting a second major renovation, with redesigned kitchens and fresh culinary offerings for summer 2027. Guests have until Jan. 3, 2027, to dine at Bacchanal before it temporarily closes on Monday, Jan. 4, for construction. The project will enhance several specialty kitchens and the dessert station.


Tetsuo Aoyagi of MUKU design studio inc. in Tokyo originally designed the buffet in 2012 and returned for Bacchanal's 2021 renovation. The 2027 redesign will stay true to his original nature-inspired concept, blending warm, natural materials with modern metallic accents. Solid-wood counters and oak-veneer shelving will pair with brushed-metal finishes throughout the open kitchens, and illuminated onyx panels will be featured in the dessert station. Sculptural pendant lighting will add a striking new element to the private dining room.


“We’re doubling down on Bacchanal Buffet with this renovation,” said Terrence O’Donnell, SVP and General Manager of Caesars Palace. “Bacchanal helped shape Caesars Palace’s culinary legacy and continues to set the standard for Las Vegas buffets. This next chapter brings fresh flavors and new experiences to the buffet, giving guests even more to look forward to when we welcome them back next summer.”


Since opening in September 2012, Bacchanal Buffet has redefined the Las Vegas buffet experience with elevated dishes prepared fresh daily by a team of specialized chefs. Spanning more than 25,000 square feet, it is one of the city’s largest buffets, featuring 10 kitchens with chef-attended action stations and more than 250 dishes. Best known for its seafood and carved meats, Bacchanal serves cuisines from around the world, including Latin, Mediterranean, Asian and American, along with made-to-order specialties.


Bacchanal Buffet is near Beijing Noodle No. 9 and Peter Luger Steak House at Caesars Palace. Until its temporary closure beginning Jan. 4, the buffet is open Monday through Thursday from 2:30 to 9 p.m. and Friday through Sunday from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. Brunch is served Friday through Sunday beginning at 9 a.m. For more information or to make a reservation through Jan. 3, guests can visit[caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&index=3&md5=c538c7d6833fa8198328c945043a4e80) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs)**


**When will Bacchanal Buffet temporarily close?** Bacchanal Buffet will temporarily close on Jan. 4, 2027, for renovations.


**When will Bacchanal Buffet reopen?** Bacchanal Buffet is scheduled to reopen in summer 2027. A specific reopening date will be announced closer to completion of the renovations.


**Why is Bacchanal Buffet closing?** The temporary closure of Bacchanal Buffet will allow Caesars Palace to complete the upcoming renovation.


**What improvements were completed in 2021?** The previous refresh included upgrades to the seafood, carving, American and Latin kitchens, entrance and dining room; new equipment across the open kitchens; and more than 30 new dishes.


**What will be included in the 2027 renovation?** The 2027 renovation will elevate the following buffet areas:


- Italian kitchen
- Mediterranean kitchen
- Asian grill and BBQ kitchen
- Sushi and sashimi kitchen
- Regional Asian specialties kitchen
- Dessert station


**Will guests be able to make reservations for the reopening?** Reservation details will be announced closer to the summer 2027 reopening.


**What are the current hours of operation for Bacchanal Buffet?** Until its temporary closure beginning Jan. 4, 2027, the buffet is open Monday through Thursday from 2:30 to 9 p.m. and Friday through Sunday from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m. Brunch is served Friday through Sunday beginning at 9 a.m.


**Where can guests find the latest information or make a reservation?** Guests can visit[caesars.com/caesars-palace/restaurants/bacchanal-buffet](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=caesars.com%2Fcaesars-palace%2Frestaurants%2Fbacchanal-buffet&index=4&md5=f3caa12218a91c8acce1386da1082d8d) for the latest information or to make a reservation through Jan. 3, 2027.


**About Caesars Palace**


Caesars Palace, the iconic Las Vegas Strip resort where every guest is treated like a Caesar, features 3,980 hotel guest rooms and[suites](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Flas-vegas%2Fsuites&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=suites&index=5&md5=f5812b4228f18c697f0667297ef983af) , including the redesigned 182-room[Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fnobu-caesars-palace&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=Nobu+Hotel+Caesars+Palace&index=6&md5=1a6dd4b2186a7165b7464e96427c8738) , the renovated Colosseum Tower and[THE VILLAS Caesars Palace](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caesars.com%2Fsuites%2Flas-vegas%2Fvillas&esheet=54643266&newsitemid=20261117566695&lan=en-US&anchor=THE+VILLAS+Caesars+Palace&index=7&md5=cf768ca889fb29d0fa0daa000432620c) , which has earned the prestigious AAA Five Diamond rating. Both Caesars Palace and Nobu Hotel Caesars Palace have also received AAA Four Diamond designations. The 85-acre resort offers diverse dining options from the award-winning Bacchanal Buffet to celebrity chef-branded restaurants, including Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN, Pronto by Giada, Amalfi by Bobby Flay, Vanderpump Cocktail Garden by restaurateur and television star Lisa Vanderpump, one of Nobu Matsuhisa’s largest Nobu restaurants, MICHELIN-starred Restaurant Guy Savoy, award-winning pastry chef Dominique Ansel’s first Las Vegas bakery, Stanton Social Italian – a dining concept in partnership with Tao Group Hospitality, legendary New York Steak House Peter Luger and Brasserie B Parisian Steakhouse by Bobby Flay. The Celebrity Food Hall features Guy Fieri’s Chicken Guy!, Bobby’s Burgers by Bobby Flay, Tortazo by Rick Bayless, Buddy V’s Pizzeria and Mokbar by Esther Choi. For the best in cocktails, destination lounges include Montecristo Cigar Bar, VISTA Cocktail Lounge, Stadia Bar and Caspian’s – a cocktail and caviar bar with Clique Hospitality. The resort also features nearly 130,000 square feet of casino space, the Caesars Race & Sportsbook at Caesars Palace with a 143-foot HD LED screen and state-of-the-art sound, a five-acre Garden of the Gods Pool Oasis, the luxurious Qua Baths & Spa, Hairdreams by Michael Boychuck, five wedding chapels and gardens, the 75,000-square-foot OMNIA Nightclub and OMNIA Dayclub & Skybar on Las Vegas Boulevard. The 4,300-seat Colosseum is the most celebrated venue in Las Vegas with an impressive legacy of superstar talent featured in an intimate, once-in-a-lifetime setting. The Colosseum currently spotlights world-class entertainers, including LISA, Cyndi Lauper, Mötley Crüe, Sting, Tim McGraw and Rod Stewart. Also, the Green Fairy Garden in front of Caesars Palace hosts ABSINTHE by Spiegelworld, an adults-only circus variety show featuring a cocktail of wild and outlandish acts. The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace showcases more than 160 boutiques and restaurants. Caesars Palace is operated by a subsidiary of Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR).
